purpose: KonfAI is a Slicer module that downloads KonfAI "Apps" (segmentation, synthetic CT, registration models) from Hugging Face or local folders, runs inference/evaluation/uncertainty on scene volumes through an external `konfai-apps` CLI, and can offload the computation to a user-configured remote GPU server. It targets clinical-research users who want deep-learning pipelines in Slicer without writing Python.
summary: Reviewed all Python sources, CMake files and the packaging layout of SlicerKonfAI. No malicious, obfuscated or exfiltrating behavior found: network use is limited to Hugging Face/PyPI lookups, a user-configured remote server, and a loopback Studio server the user is asked about. The main problem is the shared Python environment: the extension pip-installs `keyring` silently (no prompt) from `RemoteServer.__init__`/dialogs, and the KonfAI repair path pip-installs unpinned `numpy`, `requests`, `h5py`, `lxml`, etc. into Slicer's Python. Secondary issues: two icon sets referenced by code are not installed by CMake, remote tokens are passed on the child-process command line, and one `eval()` on a parameter-node string. License (Apache-2.0) and catalog entry are fine.

safety.rationale: servers.py/dialogs store remote tokens in keyring but pass them to konfai-apps as `--token` argv; app_template.py:200 uses `eval(ok)` on a parameter-node string; selection.py:461 runs a generated `-c` script into which repo id/app name are interpolated. No telemetry, no obfuscation, no unexpected data leaving the machine.

environment.rationale: RemoteServer.__init__ (servers.py:58-62) and remote_server.py:150-154 run `slicer.util.pip_install("keyring")` without any user prompt; dependencies.py:154-156 pip-installs unpinned `numpy`, `requests`, `tqdm`, `h5py`, `lxml` into Slicer's Python; PyTorch itself is correctly left to the PyTorch extension (dependencies.py:49-70).

license.rationale: Apache-2.0 LICENSE at the repository root, matching the `SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0` headers in every source file I read (e.g. KonfAI/KonfAI.py:15). No bundled binaries or weights; model/app files are downloaded at runtime from Hugging Face.

soundness.rationale: Reasonable Slicer structure: heavy imports inside functions, QProcess instead of GUI-thread blocking, observers removed in cleanup (core_widget.py:673-674), work output in slicer.util.tempDirectory (app_template.py:126). But exceptions in on_run_button are only printed (app_template.py:269-272), and Hugging Face/PyPI/remote RAM polling happens on the GUI thread with processEvents.

utility.rationale: README.md and TUTORIAL.md plus 10 tutorial screenshots and a documented workflow; unit tests exist (KonfAITest in KonfAI.py:195-228 and Testing/Python/CMakeLists.txt registering KonfAIApiContractTest.py). Overlap with existing Slicer AI tools is plausible but the app/HF model workflow is distinctive.

findings.title: `keyring` is pip-installed into Slicer's Python silently, with no user confirmation
findings.explanation: Any time a RemoteServer object is constructed (module entry when stored remote servers exist in QSettings, or when a run/check is triggered), an ImportError triggers `slicer.util.pip_install("keyring")` with no prompt. This mutates the shared Slicer environment for the user without consent, and the same pattern is repeated in both server dialogs. If the install fails or pulls a different version than expected, it affects every Slicer session, not just this module.
findings.suggestion: Bundle keyring as a declared dependency (or ask the user first via the existing ask_user_to_install_dependency helper) and disable the remote-token feature with an explanatory message when keyring is unavailable.

findings.title: Repair path pip-installs unpinned packages that Slicer bundles (numpy, requests)
findings.evidence:
slicer.util.pip_install(f"--upgrade --force-reinstall --no-deps konfai-apps=={latest}")
            slicer.util.pip_install(
                "tqdm numpy ruamel.yaml psutil tensorboard lxml h5py nvidia-ml-py requests huggingface_hub"
            )
findings.explanation: On the 'reinstall KonfAI-apps' branch the extension installs `tqdm numpy ruamel.yaml psutil tensorboard lxml h5py nvidia-ml-py requests huggingface_hub` unpinned in one pip call. If any package is missing (e.g. on a Slicer build where a dependency was not satisfied) pip resolves and installs the latest release, including its transitive requirements, which can upgrade numpy/requests under Slicer's feet. This runs only after user consent, which limits the impact.
findings.suggestion: Let konfai-apps' own metadata declare these dependencies (install it without --no-deps), or constrain them so Slicer-bundled packages such as numpy and requests are never upgraded.

findings.title: Icons referenced by the code are not installed by the module CMakeLists
findings.explanation: `core_widget.py` loads `Icons/studio.png` and `helpers.app_task_icon` loads `Icons/task_segmentation.png` / `task_registration.png` / `task_synthesis.png` / `task_app.png`, but MODULE_PYTHON_RESOURCES only lists download.png, folder.png, gear.png, KonfAI.png and refresh.png. In a package built by the extension factory those files are absent, so the Studio button and the app-selector glyphs render as empty icons for end users, even though they exist in the source tree (10 files under Resources/Icons).
findings.suggestion: Add Resources/Icons/studio.png and Resources/Icons/task_*.png to MODULE_PYTHON_RESOURCES (or list all icons in Resources/Icons).

findings.title: Remote server bearer token is passed on the child-process command line
findings.explanation: cli_args() appends `--token <token>` to the konfai-apps argv. On shared multi-user machines any local user can read the full command line of the child process (e.g. via ps), exposing the remote GPU server credentials the extension stores encrypted in the keyring. The token is only sent to a server the user configured, so the exposure is local and modest.
findings.suggestion: Pass the token through an environment variable or a 0600 temporary config/credential file rather than argv.

findings.title: `eval()` applied to a string read back from the parameter node
findings.explanation: get_remote_server splits the `RemoteServer` parameter on '|' and evaluates the fourth field to a bool. Today only the module writes that parameter, so this is not an injection path from outside, but a saved scene file can carry arbitrary parameter strings, and a crafted .mrs scene would execute code when the module runs a job with a remote server set.

findings.title: Hugging Face repo id / app name interpolated into a generated `-c` script
findings.explanation: The refresh/download action builds a Python source string with textwrap.dedent f-string interpolation of `app._repo_id` and `app._app_name` and executes it with `sys.executable -c`. `selected_files` is inserted with !r (safe), but the repo id and app name are inserted verbatim inside double quotes, so a quote character in either value would break out of the literal and inject code into the executed script. The values come from app objects the user selected, so this is a robustness/defense-in-depth issue rather than an established external attack path.
findings.suggestion: Insert these values with `{app._repo_id!r}` / `{app._app_name!r}`, or run the download in-process / from a real script file with arguments instead of -c.

findings.title: Recursive delete of a folder path taken from the app object
findings.explanation: When the user ticks 'Also delete the folder from disk' and confirms the warning dialog, `shutil.rmtree(app.get_name())` deletes whatever path the local app repository reports. The path is not validated against the app repository root and may be relative, so it resolves against Slicer's current working directory. The action is explicitly double-confirmed by the user, which limits the risk.
findings.suggestion: Resolve the app directory from the repository object and refuse to delete unless it is inside the known KonfAI app repository/cache root.

findings.title: Module import deletes KonfAILib entries from sys.modules
findings.evidence:
for _cached_module in [name for name in sys.modules if name == "KonfAILib" or name.startswith("KonfAILib.")]:
    del sys.modules[_cached_module]
findings.explanation: KonfAI.py purges every `KonfAILib*` entry from sys.modules at import time to support Slicer's Reload. That is a global interpreter side effect: sister extensions (ImpactSynth, ImpactReg) holding references to old KonfAILib classes keep stale identities, as the author's own comment acknowledges. It does not affect modules that do not import KonfAI.
findings.suggestion: Only purge on an explicit Reload path (e.g. when the module is re-executed as a reload, detectable via the wasSetupOnce property used below), or document the constraint in README.

findings.title: Run failures are swallowed with a bare print
findings.explanation: In on_run_button, any exception raised while preparing or starting the run is only `print(e)`ed and the running flag is reset; the user sees the log/progress stop but no error message. For instance a missing `konfai` module or a broken app manifest leaves the user with a silently cancelled operation.
findings.suggestion: Also report the exception in the log panel and via slicer.util.errorDisplay (with details/traceback).

findings.title: Network work on the GUI thread
findings.evidence:
def _update_resources(self) -> None:
        self._update_ram()
        self._update_vram()

    def _update_ram(self) -> None:
        """
        Update the RAM usage display and progress bar.

        If usage exceeds 80%, the progress bar color is set to red.
        """
        remote_server = self.ui.remoteServerComboBox.currentData
        from konfai import get_ram

        used_gb, total_gb = get_ram(remote_server)
findings.explanation: populate_apps() lists Hugging Face repositories and builds app objects on the GUI thread (using processEvents feedback), `_update_ram`/`_update_vram` issue an HTTP GET to the remote server every 3 s while the module is visible, and `get_latest_pypi_version` blocks up to 5 s on module entry. With a slow or unreachable server the module panel freezes during those calls.
findings.suggestion: Move the remote polling and repository listing to a worker thread or a QProcess/QtNetwork request and update the widgets from the main thread.

findings.title: One-click install and detached launch of a local web app that can drive an LLM CLI
findings.evidence:
inside_slicer = executable.startswith(slicer.app.slicerHome)
        env = dict(os.environ) if inside_slicer else dict(slicer.util.startupEnvironment())
        user_bin = os.path.expanduser("~/.local/bin")
        path = env.get("PATH", "")
        if user_bin not in path.split(os.pathsep):
            env["PATH"] = f"{path}{os.pathsep}{user_bin}" if path else user_bin
findings.explanation: The Studio button can pip-install `konfai-studio` after a confirmation dialog, launch it detached on 127.0.0.1:8730, and the launcher deliberately appends `~/.local/bin` to PATH because that is where the `claude` CLI ('Studio's default brain') lives. The server is loopback-only and the user consents, but users should understand that this third-party tool is started outside Slicer's process and keeps running after Slicer closes.
findings.suggestion: Keep the consent dialog, and document in README that Studio is a separate, persistent local web app.

not_checked: Whether `konfai-apps` / `konfai` on PyPI (installed at runtime by install_konfai) pull `torch` or other Slicer-bundled packages as transitive requirements — the package metadata could not be fetched during this review.

License terms of the Hugging Face app repositories and model weights downloaded at runtime (VBoussot/ImpactSynth, MRSegmentator-KonfAI, TotalSegmentator-KonfAI, ImpactSeg, DentalSegmentator-KonfAI) and of `konfai-studio`.
Behaviour of the external `konfai-apps` CLI itself (network destinations, what it uploads to a remote server, model handling), which is not part of this repository.
Contents of README.md and TUTORIAL.md beyond their existence and size; not read in full within this review.
Binary resources (KonfAI.png, screenshots, mp4 videos) and the .ui files, which were not parsed.
Whether the pinned commit 67776b1a corresponds to the current `main` tip (the catalog entry tracks the branch).
questions_for_author: Does `konfai-apps` (or `konfai`) declare `torch` as a dependency on PyPI? If so, `pip_install(f"konfai-apps=={latest}")` can install PyTorch outside the Slicer PyTorch extension — how is that avoided?
Why is `keyring` installed at RemoteServer construction time instead of being declared/confirmed up front?
Could Resources/Icons/studio.png and Resources/Icons/task_*.png be added to MODULE_PYTHON_RESOURCES, given the code loads them?
What license do the Hugging Face apps/weights distributed under VBoussot/* carry, and is redistribution/clinical-research use documented in README?
